title: Details Leak on OpenAI's Doughnut-Shaped Speaker - CNET
summary: OpenAI plans to release an AI smart speaker in 2027, according to a Bloomberg report on Thursday. The Bloomberg report says that the OpenAI speaker was designed with help from LoveFrom studio, launched by former Apple designer Jony Ive .
